Beyond Classrooms, Towards Research and Academic Excellence!

As a law student, I strongly believe that legal education extends beyond textbooks and courtrooms. Research provides an opportunity to identify legal challenges, question existing frameworks and explore meaningful solutions.

I am excited to share that my abstract has been accepted for presentation at the International Conference on Sustainable Development, Cultural Preservation and Indigenous Communities, organised by NLIU Bhopal in collaboration with the Tribal Research & Development Institute, Government of Madhya Pradesh.

My paper focuses on the protection of traditional knowledge associated with Bidri Art in Bidar, Karnataka, examining legal safeguards, practical challenges and preservation mechanisms.

📅 23–24 January 2027
📍 NLIU, Bhopal

This opportunity further strengthens my interest in Intellectual Property Law, Cultural Heritage Protection and Legal Research.

Looking forward to learning, presenting and contributing to meaningful academic conversations.

#LawStudent #LegalResearcher #IntellectualPropertyLaw #CulturalPreservation #NLIU
